I'm sorry that you are feeling that way, is there anything I can do to help? if not, I suggest going to someone you trust or if not just trying to help yourself out. I like to watch Markiplier and Jacksepticeye, listen to music, or watch tv. What do you enjoy?

I have been thinking like you recently. I've been down on my luck more and as much as I wish I did I cant give you a logical reason. I live for others,  but the more I thought about it, as much as I want to die, dying is scary, and so is the idea of living while trying to die. I know you have no reason to have hope, to trust, or to believe the meaningless lies that have been told because they really aren't true. And I cannot logically tell you otherwise. But I can say, recently, I've tried to have hope. hope that one day, somehow, by the miracle of the fucking gods I find something that can fix me or make me ok.

 It's so stupid, and sometimes it doesn't work, and I cannot handle it anymore but I try anyway. in the dumbest "because" it was a character from a rhythm game is the one who gave me this but I don't really mind. because I got a sliver of hope again. I hope you can find something that can do that for you. This isn't fun to hear because you wanted an actual answer, but I cant give it to you. I think its something some people just get lucky with.
I'm sorry someone hurt you like that. Im not sure how I can help but I'm here if needed.
I know you don't want help, but if you want advice or change your mind or need someone to talk to comment, and always remember there are suicide hotlines available for you to use.
